name: workspace-installation-registry
purpose: Tracks installations that change dependency state, tool state, global environment, Codex skills/plugins, or project runtime setup.

reader_guide.summary: This registry is the index for installation audit records. Open it to see what was installed, where the detailed record lives, and which rules future installation work must follow.
how_to_read: Read purpose and structure_rules before installing anything.
Use entries to find existing installation records.
Each entry points to a detailed Markdown record under _history/installations/YYYY/.
Run config-contract checks after changing registry structure or required fields.
update_triggers: A package, tool, runtime, skill, plugin, adapter, or dependency is installed, upgraded, removed, or globally configured.
A dependency manifest or lock file changes due to installation.
Installation security, license, or rollback requirements change.

reference_links.title: Open-Source Installation Policy
used_for: security, license, verification, and rollback requirements

reference_links.title: Python Packaging User Guide: pip and virtual environments
used_for: requirements file and pip installation reference

reference_links.title: OWASP Developer Guide: Dependencies
used_for: dependency version, license, source, and support fields

structure_rules.rule: Every actual install, upgrade, removal, or global configuration must have a detailed record under _history/installations/YYYY/.
structure_rules.reason: Installation changes dependency or environment state and must be reproducible and reversible.

structure_rules.rule: Create a draft record before installation and update it after installation with actual command output, versions, verification, and rollback.
structure_rules.reason: Pre-install intent and post-install reality can differ.

structure_rules.rule: Global installs require explicit justification, install location, removal path, and permission approval.
structure_rules.reason: Global installs affect future tasks and can be hard to undo.

structure_rules.rule: When installation_occurred is true, work-evaluator-agent input must include installation_record_targets.
structure_rules.reason: The close-out loop should catch missing installation audit trails.
